configurePresets.name: dist-linux
configurePresets.description: Release build with dynamically-linked Qt for redistributable installers (AppImage). Used by CI. VCPKG_HOST_TRIPLET is pinned to the target triplet: left at its default (x64-linux) vcpkg treats this as a cross-build and produces a second, separate dependency set for host tools -- 42 extra packages including a whole second Qt carrying its default features (icu, sql-psql, testlib, dbus, xcb-sm). Nothing ships from that set, it doubled CI time, and its xcb-sm default needs libSM, which the CI container does not install, so it failed the build outright.

configurePresets.name: asan-dist
configurePresets.displayName: Sanitizers on the distribution dependency set (CI)
configurePresets.description: What CI runs the sanitizer suite with. Inherits dist-linux so it shares that preset's triplet, and therefore the dependency set already built for it — configuring with the plain `asan` preset instead would fall back to the default x64-linux triplet and rebuild every dependency, static Qt included. RelWithDebInfo rather than Debug because the dist triplets are VCPKG_BUILD_TYPE=release and ship no debug dependency variants.

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.description: Builds the fuzz targets in tests/fuzz. Clang-only: libFuzzer has no GCC or MSVC equivalent, which is why this is a separate preset rather than a flag on the CI presets. Configure with -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ (or set CXX) -- the toolchain is not pinned here so the preset stays usable with whatever Clang is installed.

configurePresets.name: tsan-dist
configurePresets.displayName: ThreadSanitizer on the distribution dependency set (CI)
configurePresets.description: Thread sanitizer over the same dependency set as asan-dist, and separate from it because ASan and TSan cannot be linked into one binary. Covers what ASan cannot: the warp's row-chunk fan-out across the parked worker pool, the pooled decode/section jobs with queued delivery, and the process-wide netcdf-c mutex -- races there corrupt values rather than crashing. Run on a schedule rather than per-push: TSan slows the suite several-fold and the threading surface changes rarely.

configurePresets.name: dist-windows
configurePresets.description: Release build with dynamically-linked Qt for the NSIS installer. Requires the MSVC toolchain in the environment (CI provides it).
